title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Rutgers University-New Brunswick
description: Ten food destinations with currently posted late closing times in and around Rutgers–New Brunswick.

cards.title: Hansel 'n Griddle
cards.subtitle: 130 Easton Ave, New Brunswick
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm the night’s schedule before heading to Easton Avenue for a late sandwich, wrap, or breakfast-style meal.
cards.short_summary: An Easton Avenue counter-service option with posted midnight and 3 a.m. closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Hansel 'n Griddle posts hours until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 9 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 9 a.m.–3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: The Original Pizza City
cards.subtitle: 145 Easton Ave, New Brunswick
cards.notes: Check the day-specific closing time, then use the restaurant’s posted takeout, delivery, or dine-in options for a late meal on Easton Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A pizza-and-more restaurant whose official site posts 3 a.m. closing Monday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The Original Pizza City posts hours of 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Monday–Saturday and noon–midnight Sunday.
cards.source_title: The Original Pizza City in New Brunswick
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 3 a.m. closing Monday–Saturday; Sunday closing is midnight.

cards.title: El Rancho NJ
cards.subtitle: 98 Remsen Ave, New Brunswick
cards.notes: Plan a food stop at this Remsen Avenue Dominican restaurant and confirm availability through its official ordering or contact options before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Dominican restaurant with an official daily closing time of 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: El Rancho NJ posts daily business hours from 11 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11 a.m.–2 a.m. every day.

cards.title: C&C Pizza Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 138 French St, New Brunswick
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering page to check the current menu and make this a Friday or Saturday stop when its listed hours extend to midnight.
cards.short_summary: A French Street restaurant with pizza, sandwiches, pasta, and posted midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: C&C Pizza Restaurant posts Friday and Saturday hours from 10 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours ending at midnight.

cards.title: Pizza City on Somerset Street
cards.subtitle: 297 Somerset St, New Brunswick
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s live online-ordering page to verify service, then plan for its posted midnight weekday or 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Somerset Street pizza, sandwich, and Mexican-food counter with posted late online-ordering hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza City’s ordering page lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s online-ordering page lists midnight closing Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Douglass Pizza & Grill
cards.subtitle: 298 George St, New Brunswick
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s official site before walking over, especially on Friday or Saturday when it posts its latest closing time for pizza and grill items.
cards.short_summary: A George Street pizza-and-grill restaurant open through midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Douglass Pizza & Grill posts Friday–Saturday hours from 11 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–midnight Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Somerset Street
cards.subtitle: 1120 Somerset St, New Brunswick
cards.notes: Use the official locator to confirm whether you need the dining room or drive-thru; the posted drive-thru schedule runs later than the dining room.
cards.short_summary: A Somerset Street Taco Bell with a posted 2 a.m. drive-thru closing time most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Monday–Saturday and until 1 a.m. Sunday at 1120 Somerset Street.
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists drive-thru until 2 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 1 a.m. Sunday; use posted dine-in hours separately.

cards.title: The Atrium
cards.subtitle: College Avenue Student Center, Rutgers–New Brunswick
cards.notes: Use a meal swipe or other accepted payment and check the official dining page for current service details before choosing this College Avenue Student Center stop.
cards.short_summary: Rutgers Dining’s College Avenue Student Center destination with an 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers Dining lists The Atrium’s dine-in hours as 7 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: Rutgers Dining Services — Places to Eat
cards.access_notes: Rutgers Dining lists dine-in hours through 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday; Friday closes at 9 p.m. and weekends at 8 p.m.

cards.title: Cafe West
cards.subtitle: College Avenue Campus, Rutgers–New Brunswick
cards.notes: Check Rutgers Dining’s current listing and use the posted meal-swipe or payment rules before making Cafe West a Monday-through-Thursday late food stop.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue Campus Rutgers Dining venue open until 11 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers Dining lists Cafe West hours as 9 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: Rutgers Dining Services — Places to Eat
cards.access_notes: Rutgers Dining lists Cafe West through 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and through 8 p.m. Friday.

cards.title: Kilmer's Market
cards.subtitle: Livingston Campus, Rutgers–New Brunswick
cards.notes: Check the official Rutgers Dining listing before going, then use a meal swipe, RU Express, or cash as applicable for a late evening food or essentials stop.
cards.short_summary: A Livingston Campus market with a posted 11 p.m. Monday-through-Thursday closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers Dining lists Kilmer’s Market hours as 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: Rutgers Dining Services — Places to Eat
cards.access_notes: Rutgers Dining lists Kilmer’s Market through 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 9 p.m. Friday, and says it accepts meal swipes, RU Express, and cash.
